olivia: Trying to run the JS SDK in a Deno Edge function and Bun. Parse error pointing at `node:crypto` inside a built file (dist/cjs/crypto-fallback.js). Anyone else?

ren: That's the resolver picking up CJS/node build. Deno can't handle node: specifiers in CJS. Bun sometimes tolerates but webcrypto behavior differs.

mike: Minimal repro:
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const c = createClient({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('RW_KEY') });
await c.generate('hi');
```
Deno blows up while parsing. Bun returns but crypto.subtle operations fail silently.

olivia: Tried import_map mapping `node:crypto` -> `https://deno.land/std/node/crypto.ts` but still hit CJS artifacts. We need package-side fixes.

ren: Plan: publish an ESM "edge" build that only uses web platform APIs; avoid any `node:` imports. Then set package.json `exports` to prefer it for `import`.

mike: Example exports map:
```json
"exports":{
  ".":{
    "import":"./dist/edge/index.mjs",
    "require":"./dist/node/index.cjs"
  }
}
```
Also ship `edge.d.ts` with ambient declarations for `globalThis.crypto` so Deno TS doesn't require DOM libs.

olivia: For types: include in `edge.d.ts` something like:
```ts
declare global { var crypto: Crypto; }
export {};
```
That prevents `TS2339` on `globalThis.crypto.subtle` for users without DOM lib.

ren: Runtime adaptors: Bun's fetch/stream and webcrypto shapes differ. Add tolerant helpers: detect `globalThis.crypto?.subtle` vs `globalThis.webcrypto?.subtle` and normalize Response body handling (getReader / async iterator / node stream).

mike: Also ensure source maps in edge build don't point back to node-only sources; rewrite or strip them so Deno stack traces make sense.

olivia: CI: add deno and bun smoke tests that `import` the package and call generate; fail if any `node:` specifiers are present or the call throws. Gate them on SDK build changes.

ci-bot: Created task `sdk/deno-bun-smoke`; checklist: edge build, exports map, edge.d.ts, deno/bun smoke jobs.

ren: I'll open a draft PR with repro, failing stack, and the exports/types patch. Will add README snippet "Using with Deno/Bun" and a minimal deno.json example.

mike: Thanks. Small note: also test ESM consumers with common bundlers (esbuild/rollup) to ensure `exports` is respected.

olivia: tagging runtime & devex on the PR.
